reviews.text: Wellness Care The routine exams and consultations check each of the body’s systems and other vital signs for any symptoms of a larger issue, and further treatment can be scheduled if necessary.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Vaccinations We offer vaccines to protect your pet from harmful illnesses and diseases. Our services include “core” vaccines, or those recommended for all animals, in addition to “non-core” vaccines, or vaccines unique to your pet’s needs.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Dental Care Cavities and other dental problems can be painful for your pets just like they are for you and can lead to other health problems. We offer teeth cleaning services to promote healthy gums and teeth for your pet.

reviews.author: Pet parent

reviews.text: Reviews What Melrose says. Real reviews from pet parents who have trusted us with their family. EXCELLENT

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Dr. Ezra J. Ameis and the staff at Paw Priority are amazing. Finding a vet that you can trust is tough -especially these days where you're a sales target from the moment you walk in the door. We brought our puppy chihuahua to Dr. Ameis yesterday and couldn't have had a better experience. The entire staff is amazing, friendly, helpful and honest. We're excited to have found our vet and highly recommend Paw Priority!! THANK YOU!!

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: One of the rare independent vets still around offering amazing care, affordable pricing and great service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: If you’re looking for an amazing vet, Paw Priority is absolutely the place to go. You can genuinely tell how much they care about every pet that walks through their doors. Dr. Ameis is incredibly kind, thoughtful, and knowledgeable, and he takes the time to make you feel informed and supported. Their staff is just as wonderful. Rebecca and Jose are fantastic technicians who go above and beyond. They helped our dog Jackson recover from a pretty serious skin irritation and infection that led to hospitalization and a lot of medications. We felt supported and cared for every step of the way. reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: My cat, Blossom, had an unexpected medical emergency last night, and after calling Paw Priority, they were immediately able to accommodate her. I brought her in right before closing time, and they still treated her as a top priority (no pun intended.) They provided prompt, loving care & were able to get her all fixed up (despite her misdirected spiciness with Dr. Ameis.) They did not push for anything unnecessary and gave helpful insights into what treatments were and were not necessary, providing full transparency on cost ahead of treatment. I couldn’t recommend Paw Priority enough!
